We adopt three widely used metrics to evaluate the clustering results: Accuracy (ACC), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), and Adjusted Rand Index (ARI). For GID, we adopt two metrics: Accuracy (ACC) and F1score (F1).

For OOD intent discovery, we adopt three widely used metrics to evaluate the clustering results: Accuracy (ACC) , Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), and Adjusted Rand Index (ARI). For GID, we adopt two metrics: Accuracy (ACC) and F1score (F1), to assess the performance of the joint classification results.
